I think the fundamental disagreement here is metric of success. For me, the metric of success is that when a human finds themselves unable to use the legacy financial system due to state restrictions/censorship, Ethereum is there to catch them. For many, the metric of success is users or market cap. I think this discussion highlights the value a quick EIP-4488 could have provided though - it seems to me most core developers simply weren't aware of the urgency for action many application developers felt and still feel i think both of these are true: 1. the lack of connection of core devs to the application/ L2 layer is a persistent problem 2. 4488 was rushed, and a change of this level needs more time to be evaluated Can I be a core dapp dev?
